poll.label: Background checks
poll.description: Re-check watched sessions about every 15 minutes while backgrounded (throttled by the OS; can run late under battery saver)

foreground.label: Persistent watcher (Android)
foreground.description: Keep a foreground service polling every 60 seconds for timely alerts. Shows a permanent notification and uses more battery.

inapp.limits: Background checks cannot reliably wake a killed app — reopen the app after Force stop. Only the persistent watcher delivers after the app is swiped away, and nothing resumes after a reboot until the app is opened again.
